column1: # templ. Rule: the top-level declarations of the file. A templ component is
# function (method when it has a receiver); css and script components are
# function. The Go declarations in the file follow Go's own fixture: func is
# function, a method is method, struct and defined types are class, interface is
# interface and each method it declares is method, `type A = B` is type_alias,
# package-level const and var are constant and variable (each name of a
# `const a, b = ...` is one). Not definitions: struct fields, locals (including
# const, type and var inside a function body and `{{ x := ... }}` in a component),
# imports, the package clause, and calls such as @header(title).
